name: Sarcophagus Slime
subjectPrompt: A single terrifying Sarcophagus Slime, a detached mass of thick translucent amber ectoplasm with tapering tendrils and gel folds. A charred charcoal-black human-sized skeletal skull floats clearly visible in the center, seen through a thin amber envelope. Tiny glints of old gold in the slime and subdued smoky olive along the shaded edges. In front and at its base, thin fluid spreads like slow viscous ribbons and curls back into itself. Place a single compact weathered fragment of a stone coffin rim behind the mass, low and unobtrusive, only to establish how it has risen out of a sarcophagus. Focus on the amber entity; no coffin lid as centerpiece, no humanoid torso, no skeleton wearer, no limbs, no flesh or blood. The related Gray Ooze reference is for gel textures only. Create the amber liquid and skull around the source description.

name: Unhatched
subjectPrompt: An Unhatched, a small undead dragon hatchling skeleton from a necromancer's keep. Full four-legged figure in a forward three-quarter stance and one head. Narrow tapered draconic skull with fine curved fangs, empty sockets lit dimly pale yellow, spiny vertebrae and a single long articulated tail. Skeletal legs and fully visible tiny clawed feet. Two small arching skeletal wings retain patches of thin cracked, dry sepia membrane. Bone is old ivory with umber shading. A faint puff of dusty breath near the nostrils, low and subtle, no flame. Scale should read as a lithe young dragon, not a huge dracolich: slightly larger head, slender wing spines and short body. The original black and white reference guides the bones and look of the undead creature only. Create a distinct low poised pose. No eggshell, bits of meat, gore, armor, people or cave.
